create_extent_transform: create an ExtentTransform to extract and scale a subregion of an image to a target output size
create_resize_transform: create a ResizeTransform to resize an image from its original dimensions to new height and width
create_rotation_transform: create a RotationTransform to rotate an image by a given number of degrees counter clockwise
create_color_transform: create a ColorTransform to apply a callable photometric operation to an image without changing coordinates
create_pil_color_transform: create a PILColorTransform to apply a PIL photometric operation to an image array
